item.title: $119M Minnesota State Patrol HQ planned in Roseville
item.description: Roseville planning officials advance plans for a $119M Minnesota State Patrol headquarters that will consolidate six metro locations into one facility by 2028.

item.title: Mix of private and official data could improve Fed forecasts
item.description: Economists say private-sector data from firms like ADP, Vanguard and JPMorgan could help the Federal Reserve better forecast jobs and inflation trends.

item.title: White House ballroom vote delayed after public backlash
item.description: A federal planning panel delayed a vote on Donald Trump’s $400 million White House ballroom after tens of thousands of public comments, most opposing the project.

item.title: Milwaukee waives sprinkler permit fees for older apartments
item.description: Milwaukee will waive permit and plan review fees for installing fire sprinklers in older apartment buildings, potentially saving owners up to $30,000.

item.title: U.S. economy loses 92,000 jobs, unemployment rises to 4.4%
item.description: The U.S. economy lost 92,000 jobs in February while unemployment rose to 4.4%, raising concerns about labor market weakness and complicating Federal Reserve policy.

item.title: Just Sold: Lexington Corporate Center draws $8.98M
item.description: Minneapolis-based Meritex and nonprofit Aeon sold Twin Cities properties in Eagan and New Hope for a combined $21.6 million in separate deals.

item.title: Dominium sells St. Anthony senior apartments
item.description: Dominium sold the 169-unit Legends at Silver Lake affordable apartment community in St. Anthony to LaSalle Investment Management for $33 million.

item.title: Q&A: Rep. Spencer Igo on housing policy in Greater Minnesota
item.description: Rep. Spencer Igo discusses the Starter Homes Act, a Minnesota proposal aimed at lowering housing costs by easing zoning rules and encouraging entry-level home construction.

item.title: St. Louis Park backs 265-unit Wooddale Station apartments
item.description: St. Louis Park backs Sentinel Management’s plan for a 265-unit mixed-income apartment project with retail at the Wooddale Station redevelopment site.

item.title: Interview: Brad Hendrickson, COO, Adolfson & Peterson
item.description: Brad Hendrickson, COO and incoming CEO of Adolfson & Peterson, talks about Adolfson & Peterson’s succession planning process, AP’s workload throughout the country, and keys to success in the company’s 80-year run, among other topics.
